scientific_question: When local small-mammal abundance rises, is crowding accommodated primarily by contraction of individual space use, expansion of the population footprint, or a cross-scale combination of both?

already_established: individual home-range size commonly decreases with density
NEON Peromyscus home-range area decreases with density
habitat, latitude and density interact to influence Peromyscus home-range area
within- versus between-individual variation in space use is an established conceptual decomposition
higher density commonly increases spatial network connectedness across animal systems
literature_boundary.candidate_contribution: identify how abundance responses are partitioned between within-individual spatial variance and dispersion of individual centres within matched standardized small-mammal sessions
literature_boundary.key_reference: O'Fallon S, Pinter-Wollman N, Mabry KE. 2025. Oecologia 207:98. doi:10.1007/s00442-025-05731-2
literature_boundary.key_additional_reference: Albery GF et al. 2025. Nature Ecology & Evolution 9:2002-2013. doi:10.1038/s41559-025-02843-z

future_confirmation.response: first NEON small-mammal observations not contained in RELEASE-2026

primary_unit: species x plotID x sampling session/eventID

sampling_boundary.primary_cross_scale_pool: RELEASE-2026 records from 2015-04 onward, standard 10x10 geometry, and exactly three distinct nightuid values for the same site x plotID x eventID; this operationalizes the post-2015 pathogen-grid three-night protocol in the basic package
sampling_boundary.one_night_sessions: population-footprint development only unless a future frozen model establishes comparability

primary_geometry.exception: SRER uses 7x7 and is excluded from the primary standard-geometry contrast; it may be analyzed only under separately calibrated secondary geometry
primary_geometry.coordinate_system: nominal trapCoordinate lattice, not historical geographic latitude/longitude
primary_geometry.rationale: avoids conflating ecological spatial variance with historical geolocation/Named Location corrections; within-session geometry is defined by the sampling design

sampling_boundary.legacy_recapture_sessions: structural/development sensitivity only; not pooled into the primary future confirmation
sampling_boundary.diversity_one_night_sessions: identified structurally as one-night plot-events and not eligible for primary W/B inference
sampling_boundary.grid_completion_rule: gridCompletion is audited where available; absence cannot be silently treated as complete, and any final completeness rule is frozen before spatial effects are opened
sampling_boundary.mammalGridSamplingType_basic_package: not available/populated in the RELEASE-2026 basic-package perplotnight files used by the audit; do not require this field for primary eligibility
sampling_boundary.protocol_exception: plot-events with 4+ nights are excluded from the primary denominator and retained only as protocol/QC exceptions

candidate_individual_scale_metrics: primary coordinate candidate: equal-individual half mean pairwise squared distance among repeated locations (unbiased within-individual covariance-trace U-statistic)
alternative only if structurally estimable: session-level SCR/SECR spatial scale
candidate_population_footprint_metrics: primary coordinate candidate: half mean pairwise squared distance among matched repeat-supported individual session centres
primary mechanical sensitivity: subtract mean(W_i/k_i) centroid-noise contribution before abundance effects are opened
secondary only if prevalidated: effective occupied-trap number standardized by an effort/N/capture-frequency-preserving null
mechanical_rejection_rule: reject any footprint metric that is a deterministic or near-deterministic function of abundance, occupied-trap count, nominal grid size, or grid identity

primary_hypothesis.name: cross_scale_density_accommodation
primary_hypothesis.individual_slope: beta_W = abundance response of individual-scale spatial extent
primary_hypothesis.population_slope: beta_B = abundance response of population-footprint spatial extent
primary_hypothesis.interpretation: additional individuals are accommodated more by spatial packing/compression at the individual scale than by proportional expansion of the population footprint

abundance_candidates: resolved unique individuals / MNKA-like session count
closed or spatial capture-recapture density where estimable

allowed_summaries: individual counts with at least two coordinate-bearing captures
forbidden_before_gate_freeze: distinct observed location-change status used for eligibility

required_controls: audit repeat-capture support versus session abundance without conditioning on observed displacement
fixed-footprint mechanical null across varying sampled individual count
same prospectively defined individual-support rule for primary W/B comparison
pre-effect audit of repeat-supported fraction across abundance/support classes without opening spatial distances
standard 10x10 and SRER 7x7 geometries must not be pooled without separate calibration
primary coordinate system uses nominal trapCoordinate lattice; geographic-coordinate sensitivity is secondary and requires current geoNEON/locations metadata

replication_requirement.exact_minimums: freeze after effect-blind RELEASE-2026 structural audit and copy unchanged to future-response contract

stop_rules: stop if both spatial scales are not jointly estimable across replicated species and sites
stop if footprint metric is mechanically driven by abundance
stop if within-individual metric is dominated by sparse recapture support
stop if effort or taxonomy semantics cannot be frozen prospectively
do not rescue future failure with post-hoc taxa, thresholds, metrics, habitat moderators, or incompatible sampling designs

individual_candidate.name: equal-individual half mean pairwise squared within-individual distance
individual_candidate.minimum_support: k_i >= 2 valid coordinate-bearing captures; support does not require distinct coordinates or observed movement; singleton within-individual spread is unresolved, not zero
individual_candidate.property: equals trace of unbiased sample covariance of observed locations

population_candidate.name: half mean pairwise squared distance among individual session centres
population_candidate.property: equals trace of unbiased sample covariance of individual centres
population_candidate.mechanical_null: under iid draws from an unchanged centre distribution, E[B] is invariant to sampled individual count m
population_candidate.centroid_noise_correction: B_debiased = B_observed - mean_i(W_i / k_i) under iid repeated-location measurement benchmark
population_candidate.primary_support_cohort: exactly the same repeat-captured, coordinate-supported individuals contributing to W; an all-individual B is sensitivity only

mechanical_metric_preference.common_scale: W and B are squared-distance variance quantities; matched transformations are required for slope comparison
mechanical_metric_preference.centroid_uncertainty: primary mechanical plan is to report raw B and prespecified B_debiased = B_observed - mean(W_i/k_i); if synthetic/grid audits show the correction is invalid under the observation process, abandon coordinate decomposition before ecological slopes are opened
mechanical_metric_preference.primary_abundance_boundary: N describes the session population, not the number of individuals eligible for W

external_discovery_candidate.dataset: Portal Project rodent captures at pinned source commit 72d7ff8568052763bf6899dc462e285684cf20f6
external_discovery_candidate.role_if_structurally_eligible: possible independent discovery/triangulation system; ecological effects require a separate frozen contract
external_discovery_candidate.role_if_not_structurally_eligible: close Portal route without redefining session scale or pooling across incompatible temporal units

scenarios: standard NEON 10x10 fixed detector grid with latent centres across full 10x10
standard NEON 10x10 fixed detector grid with latent centres restricted to central 8x8
mechanical_support_selection.captures_per_repeat_supported_individual: discrete uniform 2..3 in the primary synthetic audit, matching the maximum distinct-night support available within a three-night pathogen event
mechanical_support_selection.selection_rule: choose the smallest candidate m passing all criteria in every prespecified scenario; if none pass, STOP
mechanical_support_selection.relationship_to_real_support: select the synthetic minimum from standard 10x10 scenarios only, then intersect it with the RELEASE-2026 effect-blind standard-grid support frontier; never lower it because real-data support is sparse

secondary_geometry.rule: calibrate separately; SRER may not define or lower the primary standard-grid support threshold

mechanical_support_selection.note: the synthetic support threshold is invalid if calculated with k>3 for the three-night primary design

taxonomy_integrity.primary_unit: NEON published taxonID concept; do not force cryptic composite taxon IDs to species
official_metadata_to_audit: consistency of taxonID across repeated captures of the same tagID within eventID
taxonomy_integrity.replication_preference: future generality should span multiple resolved genera, not merely multiple taxon concepts within Peromyscus
taxonomy_integrity.selection_boundary: taxonomy rules must be frozen from metadata/support only before W, B, or density effects are opened
